topic: Protein source and testosterone in men over 50
title: Men Over 50: Protein Source May Matter More Than You Think
script: Men over fifty, where protein comes from may matter. One medicine habit comes last. In over twenty-five hundred men, more animal protein, especially dairy, tracked with lower testosterone; plant protein tracked higher. That's association, not proof, so don't overhaul meals or stop prescriptions. First, judge your overall pattern, not one plate. Second, if you eat protein, vary sources across the week. Third, with fatigue or low libido, ask about labs. The medicine habit? Review supplements and medicines with your clinician before blaming food. Patterns matter more than headlines. topic: Occasional cannabis use and stroke risk in adults
title: Even Occasional Cannabis Linked to Higher Stroke Odds
script: Occasional cannabis? In over 440,000 Americans, occasional users had 40% higher odds of reporting stroke history. That's association, not proof; causes aren't settled. First, don't assume occasional means harmless. Second, tell your clinician about products, including edibles, frequency, and method. Third, review blood pressure, smoking, and other stroke risks. One disclosure matters most: be specific before changing anything. Bring details to your next visit. Never stop prescribed medicine without advice. One honest conversation beats one scary headline. Ask what actually changes your risk. This is general education, not personal advice. Want heart-smart after-fifty tips? Follow.
